+    def test_inherited_ordering_with_minus_pk(self):
+        class Parent(models.Model):
+            class Meta:
+                ordering = ['-pk']
+
+        class Child(Parent):
+            pass
+
+        # The child should inherit the ordering
+        self.assertEqual(Child._meta.ordering, ['-pk'])
+
+        qs = Child.objects.all()
+        sql, params = qs.query.sql_with_params()
+        print("SQL:", sql)
+        # The SQL should contain ORDER BY ... DESC for the pk
+        self.assertIn('ORDER BY', sql)
